method: Enumerate the 8192 exact Q1481 raw x-orbit representatives, select the four whose cofactor-projected orbit keys match Q1488's verified ordinary N53 relation, recover signed Frobenius raw lifts for its four public subgroup points, and check that their sum is one of Q1482's 428 raw target x preimages. Independently check the three chained S3 links, all four raw cyclic windows, cofactor projection, subgroup membership, four distinct folded columns, and the public group sum.
success_gate: All four Q1488 subgroup points have raw window lifts; their signed raw sum selects a Q1482 target-preimage x and satisfies the exact three-link S3 chain on the unchanged public target.
failure_interpretation: If the gate fails, retain the failure and investigate a factor-base or encoding mismatch before interpreting Q1482/Q1487 search timeouts as solver hardness.
measurement_scope: Oracle-assisted correctness bridge for one already known ordinary relation; this does not measure natural yield, unpinned solver cost, a one-target DLP, or N131 complete work.
